skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target and enters [Berserk] for 1 turn. [Berserk]: Increases DMG by 30%.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 150% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the target. [Internal Injury]: When the affected unit is attacked, takes DMG equal to 140% of Silverfang's ATK. The effect disappears after triggering once.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 187.5% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the target. [Internal Injury]: When the affected unit is attacked, takes DMG equal to 160% of Silverfang's ATK. The effect disappears after triggering once.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, increases all allies' Block Rate by 30% for 2 turns. When an allied character successfully triggers Block, gains [Tenacity]. [Tenacity]: Absorbs DMG equal to 7% of Max HP. Can trigger up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. At the start of battle, grants the whole team 30% Block rate for 2 turns. After an ally character triggers Block, they gain [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 8% of their own HP, up to 4 times per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. At the start of battle, grants the whole team 30% Block rate for 2 turns. After an ally character triggers Block, they gain [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 8.5% of their own HP, up to 4 times per turn).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
